text:
Sapporo in winter is magical.
It's also slippery.
Pavements freeze from mid-December to February.
Save this 4-step checklist before you book 👇

📌 Full guide 👉 https://japanbystation.com/sapporo-where-to-stay-first-trip

1️⃣ Stay near an underground entrance
Sapporo Station, Odori and Susukino
are linked by underground walkways.
Less walking on ice.

2️⃣ Pack boots with good grip
Take small steps, with your weight low.
Most convenience stores sell anti-slip spikes.

3️⃣ Tap Suica at the airport
The Rapid Airport train needs no booking.
Only car 4 is reserved.
Fastest trip: 33 minutes, ¥1,230.

4️⃣ Check the Snow Festival dates
It runs 4 to 11 February 2027,
in Odori Park and on Susukino's main street.
Hotels there fill first.
Going that week? Book early, with a flexible rate.

💬 Our take
First winter trip? Stay in Odori.
About 10 minutes underground to the JR station,
and one stop to Susukino's lamb barbecue grills.
